question: Should memory-core hybrid search allow keyword-only FTS hits below minScore to survive when another hybrid result is already strict?
rationale: This is a retrieval-policy choice that changes what persisted memory can enter agent context, and the branch also overlaps adjacent CJK and multimodal memory-search work.

options.title: Accept Bounded Keyword Preservation
options.body: Refresh the conflicts and land this manager-boundary fix so FTS-proven keyword-only rows can survive while maxResults still bounds the returned window.

options.title: Keep minScore Absolute
options.body: Reject or narrow this PR if maintainers want minScore to remain a hard cutoff even for keyword-only lexical hits.

options.title: Unify Memory Retrieval Policy First
options.body: Pause this PR and decide the CJK, keyword-only, and multimodal hybrid scoring changes together before landing any one branch.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Keyword Preservation
recommendation.body: Refresh the conflicts and land this manager-boundary fix so FTS-proven keyword-only rows can survive while maxResults still bounds the returned window.
